method: Tissue-restricted Reinhard mean/std matching in uint8 CIELAB to one official GigaTIME H&E control, with Gaussian edge blending; no spatial resampling
visual_review: Official-reference LAB matching visibly reduced hematoxylin contrast but retained nuclear coordinates. The virtual DAPI remained broad and confluent, with no improvement in the independent StarDist overlap. The blood-rich development preflight image became implausibly cyan after normalization, so it was not inferred.
limit: One failed fit-field inference does not exclude every stain normalization method; no test patient was used for tuning.
